name: Wooden Lute
Effect: +2 Charisma when performing
Description: A simple lute made from carved oak with six gut strings. Favored by wandering minstrels.

name: Traveler's Lute
Effect: +4 Charisma when performing
Description: A compact lute with a rounded body, built for long journeys. Its polished maple finish resists weather.

name: Elven Harp
Effect: Heals 5 HP to all allies within earshot
Description: A delicate harp carved from living silverwood, strung with spider-silk threads that shimmer faintly blue.

name: Masterwork Violin
Effect: +8 Charisma, intimidates enemies on crit
Description: A flawless violin of dark rosewood, with fittings of inlaid ivory. Its bow sings when drawn.

name: War Drum Bow
Effect: +3 attack damage when played before combat
Description: A bow-shaped string instrument wrapped in tanned hide. When struck, it emits a deep warlike tone.

name: Dwarven Bass Lyre
Effect: +3 Fortitude, resists fear while playing
Description: A heavy lyre forged from black iron, with steel strings that vibrate with a guttural hum.

name: Celestial Zither
Effect: Summons divine light that blinds undead
Description: A long zither of polished moonstone, strung with threads of captured starlight. It hums with celestial energy.

name: Abyssal Guitar
Effect: Deals 10 shadow damage to all enemies
Description: A jagged guitar of volcanic obsidian, strung with chains of midnight iron. Smoke curls from its sound holes.

name: Oak Flute
Effect: +1 Charisma when performing
Description: A simple flute carved from a single piece of seasoned oak, with six finger holes.

name: Bard's Pan Flute
Effect: +2 Charisma, calms hostile animals
Description: Seven hollow reeds of decreasing length, bound together with twine and tipped with copper.

name: Silver Trumpet
Effect: Boosts party morale (+2 all stats)
Description: A gleaming trumpet of hammered silver with a flared bell. Its note carries across any battlefield.

name: Dragonbone Horn
Effect: Terrifies enemies, causes flee on low HP
Description: A curved war horn carved from the femur of an ancient dragon, banded with red gold.

name: Obsidian Ocarina
Effect: Opens sealed doors in ancient ruins
Description: A teardrop-shaped ocarina of polished obsidian with golden rune-etched finger holes.

name: Elven Oboe
Effect: Grants sleep to enemies on failed save
Description: A slender oboe of pale birchwood, with silver keys and a double reed that produces a haunting tone.

name: Abyssal Pipe
Effect: Summons spectral minions for 3 rounds
Description: A set of blackened iron pipes bound in chains, wreathed in green ghostly flame when played.

name: Tempest Saxophone
Effect: Calls a gust of wind that knocks back enemies
Description: A curved brass saxophone with stormcloud-blue patina. Lightning crackles along its keys when blown hard.

name: War Tuba
Effect: +5 armor to party for 2 rounds
Description: A massive brass tuba wrapped in steel plating. Its deep blast can be heard for miles.

name: Traveler's Drum
Effect: +2 Charisma when performing
Description: A small cylindrical drum of stretched goatskin over a cedar frame, carried on a shoulder strap.

name: Brass Tambourine
Effect: +1 Dexterity, distracts enemies
Description: A wooden frame fitted with pairs of brass jingles, wrapped in tooled leather.

name: War Gong
Effect: Stuns enemies for 1 round on crit
Description: A heavy bronze gong mounted on a lacquered stand. Its deep resonance shakes the ground.

name: Dwarven War Drums
Effect: +6 attack damage to party for 3 rounds
Description: Twin drums of iron and dragonhide, strapped to a harness. They boom with the fury of the forge.

name: Serpent Maracas
Effect: Poisons enemies on failed save
Description: Two gourd shakers wrapped in iridescent snake skin, filled with venom-coated beads.

name: Thunder Chimes
Effect: Deals lightning damage to nearby enemies
Description: Seven iron chimes of varying length hung from a steel frame. Lightning arcs between them when shaken.

name: Celestial Bells
Effect: Revives one fallen ally with full HP
Description: A set of golden bells inscribed with holy symbols, suspended on a crystal frame. They ring without being touched.

name: Shadow Cymbals
Effect: Disorients enemies, -3 accuracy for 2 rounds
Description: Two cymbals of dark tarnished brass that seem to absorb light. Their crash echoes unnaturally.

name: Bone Xylophone
Effect: Summons skeletal minions for 2 rounds
Description: A xylophone fashioned from polished bones of various creatures, laid out on a frame of black iron.

name: Singing Sword
Effect: +10 damage, weapon also functions as instrument
Description: A slender longsword with runic engravings that hum a battle hymn when swung. Plays a melody when laid flat.

name: Enchanted Harp
Effect: Casts mass healing spell (50 HP to all allies)
Description: A harp of living crystal with strings of pure mana. Its music bends reality and mends wounds.

name: Ghostly Organ
Effect: Summons a phantasmal orchestra, terrifies all enemies
Description: A portable pipe organ of spectral iron and ghostwood. Its keys are cold to the touch and its pipes breathe mist.

name: Dragon's Throat
Effect: Breathes a cone of fire when played loudly
Description: A curved horn carved from a dragon's throat bone, still warm and faintly pulsing.

name: Bard's Lute of Holding
Effect: Stores up to 10 items inside the soundbox
Description: A lute that appears ordinary until opened, revealing an impossible interior space of swirling darkness.

name: Whispering Flute
Effect: Grants invisibility for 1 round when played softly
Description: A translucent flute of pale blue glass that seems to vanish when held at certain angles.

name: Doom Bells
Effect: Instantly kills enemies below 10% HP
Description: Three black iron bells that ring of their own accord. The sound brings death to the weak-willed.

name: Void Drum
Effect: Opens a portal to a random plane for 1 round
Description: A frameless drum of pure darkness that floats at waist height. Its beat warps space itself.

name: Fairy Pipes
Effect: Summons 2 pixie allies for 4 rounds
Description: Tiny pipes of woven flower stems and spider silk, enchanted to never wilt. They smell of fresh rain.
